name: Time-series decompositions from the solver registry
description: Two sines and noise decomposed by EEMD, VMD, wavelets, STL, SSA and synchrosqueezing, each built by name from SolverRegistry (examples/solvers/01_time_series_decompositions.py; the noise is seeded here, the script's is not, and the script prints only output shapes, so there are no committed numbers to compare).
